name: Saint Peter Port (Guernsey)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the parish seal: a blue ring inscribed 'ST. PIERRE PORT — GUERNESEY' around the three lions of Guernsey on red.
history: The parish of Saint Peter Port, Guernsey's capital, flies a white flag with its seal. No adoption date has been published.

features.role: parish seal with the Guernsey lions
